title: Jude and the Deadline
author: Ada Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Thackeray, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
